deadline.value: No fixed deadline: applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and each term's intake stays open until a month before it starts. Complete your application by the OGS deadline (typically March 1) to be considered for Queen's awards.
deadline.quote: The applications for each term are open up to one month before that term starts. | Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Only applications completed by the OGS application deadline (typically March 1) will be considered for Queen’s awards and scholarships.

gre_subject.value: No GRE (general or Chemistry subject) is required.
gre_subject.quote: The GREs are not required for admission to Chemistry graduate programs.

gre_general.quote: The GREs are not required for admission to Chemistry graduate programs.

fee_waiver.value: The department does not waive or refund the application fee.
fee_waiver.quote: The department does not waive or refund the application fee.

english_waiver.value: Exempt from the English test if you recently studied at least one full year at an English-medium institution, with an official Medium of Instruction letter.
english_waiver.quote: If you have recently studied for at least one complete year at an institution where English is the official language of instruction, you can be exempted from the English Language Proficiency Test. | In this case, you will need to provide an official Medium of Instruction letter from your institution.

supervisor.value: You can apply without one, but a supervisor must agree to take you before an offer is made; contact faculty first.
supervisor.quote: An applicant must have secured a supervisor before an offer of admission can be made.

funding.value: All full-time PhD students, domestic and international, are guaranteed financial support for up to four years.
funding.quote: All full-time graduate students, both domestic and international, are guaranteed financial support for up to two years in the Master's program and up to four years in the PhD program.

entry_route.value: PhD normally follows an MSc; direct-entry PhD from a 4-year bachelor's needs an A (85%) average and strong research experience.
entry_route.quote: We accept applicants for the MSc, MASc, PhD, and direct-entry PhD. | Minimum total average of A (85%).

notes: Starts in September, January or May. Supervisor confirms interest before the admissions committee reviews the file.
